snippet.title: GUNTOUCHABLES - Narrated Trailer
snippet.description:
GUNTOUCHABLES is a co-op doomsday roguelike for 1-4 players. You play as a gun-toting group of 'preppers' trying to reclaim the world from an ever-evolving horde of mutants, constantly working to develop new unique ways to kill you.

The game is being developed by @Game_Swing and published by Ghost Ship Publishing
--------------------

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543510/GUNTOUCHABLES/
